description: Where a customer goes to buy credits, and how the app is told. A singleType because there is one answer: several rows would raise the question of which applies, and the app must never have to decide that. The app renders this URL; it does NOT handle the payment -- the gateway, the webform and the settlement all live here in ERPNext, which is why nothing about who vouches for money changes when a gateway is switched on.

fields.description: Off until a URL is set and you are ready for customers to see it. The app shows no purchase button while this is off, which is what makes switching it on a deliberate act rather than a side effect of filling in a field.
fields.label: Is Enabled

fields.description: Where a customer goes to buy credits: your payment webform, or a page that starts one. The app renders a link to exactly this and does nothing else with it. HTTPS is required -- a payment link served over plain HTTP can be rewritten in transit, and the customer would be paying whoever got there first.
fields.label: Purchase URL

fields.description: What the button says. Left as the default it reads sensibly; change it if your customers know the purchase page by another name.
fields.label: Link Label

fields.description: OPTIONAL, and the difference between a link and a handoff. Set it (for example `ref`) and the app appends the purchase's reference to the URL -- `?ref=AB12-CD34` -- so your webform arrives with the customer already identified and nothing has to be retyped. Leave it blank for a plain link. Without it, one URL cannot say WHICH purchase is being paid, and the reference becomes something a person types, which is how references stop matching.
fields.label: Reference Parameter

fields.description: Shown beside the purchase button, so the customer knows what they are about to do and what they will need afterwards.
fields.label: Help Text

name: Rest Credit Purchase Link
